dz: 为了使贵族西化，俄罗斯沙皇彼得一世对除神职人员和农民之外的所有人征收胡须税。
de: In an effort to Westernize his nobility, Tsar Peter I of Russia imposes a tax on beards for all men except the clergy and peasantry.
